messages:
Noah (Infra Lead): Thanks for the great all-hands today. Opening a short thread for a few follow-ups people asked about: capacity safety nets, rollback plan for the autoscaler canary, and procurement timelines. Will update as I get answers.

Izzy (SRE): Can you outline the rollback criteria for the autoscaler canary? We want a clear hook for emergency aborts.

Noah (Infra Lead): Rollback criteria (high level):
- sustained p99 latency increase > 25% for >10min on canary routes
- error rate spike > 3x baseline for >5min
- throughput regressions > 20% impacting customer SLOs
If any trigger fires, canary aborts and we automatically route 100% back to previous policy. Ops will send a PagerDuty alert and open a postmortem thread.

Carmen (Product): Is there a way to opt customers out of cross-region bursting while canary runs? We had a couple of enterprise asks.

Noah (Infra Lead): Yes: per-route "cross-region-burst" checkbox in Console. Default is ON for hosted; Dedicated contracts can request OFF by default. We'll also add a banner during the canary.

Ravi (Procurement): Procurement update: PO-12188 placed for EMEA mixed A100/H100 buffer. Vendor expects initial shipment window 2123610000-2123680000. Rack and power confirmations due 2123570000.

Izzy (SRE): What GPU mix will be in the initial EMEA buffer? Customers will need to know perf expectations.

Noah (Infra Lead): Initial mix: ~60% A100, 40% H100 in the first wave. We'll flip the proportions as H100 ramps in the following wave. We'll publish a simple diff in the model catalog (latency/throughput deltas) once benchmarks complete.

Izzy (SRE): Autoscaler policy snippet being canaried (for reference):

```
autoscaler_policy:
  local_warm_fraction: 0.12
  allow_cross_region_burst: true
  predicted_p99_threshold_ms: 170
  rollback_monitoring:
    p99_latency_window_mins: 10
    error_spike_factor: 3
```

Carmen (Product): Can Console show the predicted p99 delta for a given route if it would burst cross-region? That will help users decide opt-out.

Noah (Infra Lead): Yes, we'll add a "predicted p99 delta" badge next to routing preferences (example: "+80-130ms expected if cross-region"). Carmen, please own the copy for the banner and KB.

alpha-bot: Canary deployment initiated for autoscaler v1.4.5  group: 3% traffic. Logs: https://ci.redwood/canary-2123456789

Izzy (SRE): For teams worried about thread starvation/cold KV on cross-region bursts, any quick mitigations?

Noah (Infra Lead): Recommend enabling prefix-local cache and a small warm buffer for chat-heavy routes. We'll also ship an internal helper script to prime top prefixes for high-volume tenants.

Ravi (Procurement): Note: if rack confirmation missed by 2123570000, vendor will push shipment by one full window. Please coordinate with data-center ops.

Carmen (Product): Action items: 1) Add cross-region opt-out to Console route UI; 2) Banner messaging for canary; 3) KB article with expected latency deltas. I'll sync with UX.

Izzy (SRE): I'll monitor canary dashboards and post alerts to #incidents if anything looks off.

Noah (Infra Lead): Thanks all 44b. If the canary is green for 24 hours we'll plan progressive rollout and post the exact schedule here. Otherwise we'll roll back and investigate. Closing thread for now; DM me for customer-sensitive follow-ups. :wave:
